title: Practical notes and operating rules — D5
purpose: Scale and cost for Practical notes and operating rules: authoritative documentation, assumptions, project safety, budgets, least privilege, cleanup, and verification dates.
routing_rationale: Use the D5 lens to keep authoritative documentation, assumptions, project safety, budgets, least privilege, cleanup, and verification dates connected to an explicit owner, evidence path, and recovery action.
summary: Keep architecture work safe and current with authoritative sources, explicit assumptions, project guardrails, and cleanup rules.

nodes.label: Architecture Question
nodes.detail: The claim or action that needs a defensible answer.

nodes.label: Authoritative Documentation
nodes.detail: The source used to verify time-sensitive behavior.

nodes.label: Assumptions and Limits
nodes.detail: What is believed, what is unknown, and what may change.

nodes.label: Project Guardrails
nodes.detail: The safe boundary before any cloud action.

nodes.label: Runbook and Cleanup
nodes.detail: The reversible operational path and deletion verification.

nodes.label: Verification Date
nodes.detail: When the claim must be checked again.

nodes.label: Approved Decision
nodes.detail: The result that can be handed to a reviewer or operator.

scenarios.label: A time-sensitive claim is outdated

scenarios.label: A cloud action bypasses guardrails
scenarios.root_cause: The wrong project, identity, region, or budget is used.

scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Project Guardrails and any downstream decision depending on it.

scenarios.label: Cleanup is assumed rather than verified
